reviews.title: Compact size to use at home or outdoor activities.
reviews.review_text: I read the dimensions before I placed the order. It's small. But it meets what I need. This is only for me to use at home. Most of the time, I use it to look for items in the corners. Or sometime I brought it with me when I went out for run with my kids. They like to check the woods along the greenways.

reviews.title: Compact and bright for it's size
reviews.review_text: I can't speak to durability long term, but it seems pretty solidly built. Since it uses one AAA battery, replacements are cheap and readily available. It you want a rechargeable battery, you can just buy rechargeable batteries instead of buying something with a proprietary battery that will eventually wear out. Seems to put out a lot of light for it's size, but I don't know how long the battery will last. It's one drawback, is that the switch button sticks out, so it can accidentally be turned on. It might also crack and compromise the flashlight's water resistance.

it was stolen but i used it constantly for a week or so its very tiny which worked out for me as most nights i end up with it in my mouth as i wrestle with a cat or two trying to get them inside and not eaten. great light, perfect amount of lumen, so-so on battery life but i havent been happy with that in products for a while.
Sturdy, quality mechanism. Not my first Coast flashlight.
